body.statement: For every admissible compact family \(\mathcal K\) and every \(\varepsilon>0\), \[\sup_{Q\in\mathcal K}P_{N,Q}\!\left(\left\|\sqrt N[\widehat\theta_T-\theta_T]_Q-N^{-1/2}\sum_{i=1}^N[\psi_{\theta,T}(\xi_i)]_Q\right\|>\varepsilon\right)\to0.\] The limiting vector is \([D\Psi_T(\beta_0,\sigma^2,\tau^2,P_{0X})[\mathcal A_T\mathbb Z_T^{\mathrm{full}}]]_Q\sim\mathcal N(0,[\Omega_\theta]_Q)\). The observable covariance estimator is uniformly consistent for exactly this influence covariance: for every \(\varepsilon>0\), \(\sup_{Q\in\mathcal K}P_{N,Q}(\|[\widehat\Omega_\theta-\Omega_\theta]_Q\|>\varepsilon)\to0\). Consequently, \[\liminf_{N\to\infty}\inf_{Q\in\mathcal K}P_{N,Q}\{[\theta_{T,t}]_Q\in[\mathcal C_{N,t}]_Q\text{ for every }1\le t\le T\}\ge1-\alpha.\] Equality holds pointwise at any \(Q\) for which the maximum absolute coordinate of \(\mathcal N(0,[\Omega_\theta]_Q)\) has a continuous nondegenerate distribution.
body.justification: The band supports simultaneous claims about the entire dynamic treatment-effect path without an unobservable active-coordinate set.
body.gap: The published Causal-MP confidence-interval discussion is heuristic, while generic Gaussian-max theory does not derive the common-disorder and nuisance influence terms.
body.consumer: The one-batch, zero-ridge \(\texttt{CFEEstimator}\) can return analytic simultaneous path bands, including at zero-variance coordinates.
